stories.title: Consent Core Logic Enforcement Engine
stories.description: Implement core ConsentService logic to enforce Tier 1 vs Tier 2 rules, including de-identification (Safe Harbor), storage gating, and upgrade/downgrade transitions across a session.

stories.title: Consent API Exposure via Tool Router
stories.description: Expose consent capture and update operations through tool_router with validated inputs, enabling the chat agent to trigger consent flows and persist decisions.

stories.title: Conversation Summarization and De-identification Pipeline
stories.description: Implement pipeline to summarize conversations and apply HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification before any storage when only Tier 1 consent is present.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering consent tier enforcement, storage blocking, de-identification correctness, and audit logging behavior across services.

stories.title: End-to-End Consent Flow Integration in Chat Loop
stories.description: Integrate consent workflow into main FastAPI chat loop, ensuring consent prompts, state tracking, and enforcement occur seamlessly during user interactions.
